class YQError(Exception):
    pass


@dataclass
class Node:
    kind: str
    value: Any = None
    raw: Optional[str] = None
    style: Optional[str] = None

    def clone(self) -> "Node":
        return copy.deepcopy(self)


def empty_node() -> Node:
    return Node("empty", None)


def null_node(raw: Optional[str] = None) -> Node:
    return Node("null", None, raw=raw)


def bool_node(value: bool, raw: Optional[str] = None) -> Node:
    return Node("bool", bool(value), raw=raw)


def int_node(value: int, raw: Optional[str] = None) -> Node:
    return Node("int", int(value), raw=raw)


def float_node(value: float, raw: Optional[str] = None) -> Node:
    return Node("float", float(value), raw=raw)


def string_node(value: str, raw: Optional[str] = None) -> Node:
    return Node("string", str(value), raw=raw)


def seq_node(items: Optional[List[Node]] = None, style: Optional[str] = None) -> Node:
    return Node("seq", items or [], style=style)


def map_node(items: Optional[Dict[str, Node]] = None, style: Optional[str] = None) -> Node:
    return Node("map", items or {}, style=style)


def is_scalar(node: Node) -> bool:
    return node.kind in {"empty", "null", "bool", "int", "float", "string"}


def semantic_node(node: Node) -> Node:
    if node.kind == "empty":
        return null_node()
    return node


def node_truthy(node: Node) -> bool:
    node = semantic_node(node)
    if node.kind == "null":
        return False
    if node.kind == "bool":
        return bool(node.value)
    return True


def node_tag(node: Node) -> str:
    node = semantic_node(node)
    return {
        "null": "!!null",
        "bool": "!!bool",
        "int": "!!int",
        "float": "!!float",
        "string": "!!str",
        "seq": "!!seq",
        "map": "!!map",
    }[node.kind]


def node_to_python(node: Node) -> Any:
    node = semantic_node(node)
    if node.kind == "null":
        return None
    if node.kind in {"bool", "int", "float", "string"}:
        return node.value
    if node.kind == "seq":
        return [node_to_python(item) for item in node.value]
    if node.kind == "map":
        return {key: node_to_python(value) for key, value in node.value.items()}
    raise AssertionError(f"unknown node kind: {node.kind}")


def python_to_node(value: Any, style: Optional[str] = None) -> Node:
    if value is None:
        return null_node()
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return bool_node(value)
    if isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool):
        return int_node(value)
    if isinstance(value, float):
        return float_node(value)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return string_node(value)
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return seq_node([python_to_node(item, style=style) for item in value], style=style)
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return map_node({str(key): python_to_node(val, style=style) for key, val in value.items()}, style=style)
    raise YQError(f"unsupported value type: {type(value).__name__}")


def nodes_equal(left: Node, right: Node) -> bool:
    return node_to_python(semantic_node(left)) == node_to_python(semantic_node(right))


def merge_nodes(left: Node, right: Node) -> Node:
    left = semantic_node(left)
    right = semantic_node(right)
    if left.kind == "map" and right.kind == "map":
        merged: Dict[str, Node] = {}
        for key, value in left.value.items():
            merged[key] = value.clone()
        for key, value in right.value.items():
            if key in merged:
                merged[key] = merge_nodes(merged[key], value)
            else:
                merged[key] = value.clone()
        return map_node(merged, style=left.style or right.style)
    return right.clone()


@dataclass
class ParsedLine:
    indent: int
    text: str


def strip_inline_comment(text: str) -> str:
    in_single = False
    in_double = False
    depth = 0
    escape = False
    for index, char in enumerate(text):
        if in_double:
            if escape:
                escape = False
            elif char == "\\":
                escape = True
            elif char == '"':
                in_double = False
            continue
        if in_single:
            if char == "'":
                in_single = False
            continue
        if char == '"':
            in_double = True
            continue
        if char == "'":
            in_single = True
            continue
        if char in "{[":
            depth += 1
            continue
        if char in "}]":
            depth = max(0, depth - 1)
            continue
        if char == "#" and depth == 0:
            if index == 0 or text[index - 1].isspace():
                return text[:index].rstrip()
    return text.rstrip()


def split_documents(text: str) -> List[str]:
    docs: List[List[str]] = [[]]
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if line.strip() == "---":
            docs.append([])
        else:
            docs[-1].append(line)
    return ["\n".join(doc) for doc in docs]


def prepare_lines(text: str) -> List[ParsedLine]:
    lines: List[ParsedLine] = []
    for raw_line in text.splitlines():
        stripped = raw_line.lstrip(" ")
        if not stripped:
            continue
        if stripped.startswith("#"):
            continue
        indent = len(raw_line) - len(stripped)
        text_no_comment = strip_inline_comment(stripped)
        if not text_no_comment:
            continue
        lines.append(ParsedLine(indent, text_no_comment))
    return lines


INT_RE = re.compile(r"[-+]?\d+")
FLOAT_RE = re.compile(r"[-+]?(?:\d+\.\d*|\.\d+)(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?|[-+]?\d+[eE][-+]?\d+")


def parse_single_quoted(text: str) -> str:
    body = text[1:-1]
    return body.replace("''", "'")


def parse_scalar_token(text: str, preserve_raw: bool = True) -> Node:
    if text == "":
        return string_node("", raw='""' if preserve_raw else None)
    if text.startswith('"') and text.endswith('"'):
        return string_node(json.loads(text), raw=text if preserve_raw else None)
    if text.startswith("'") and text.endswith("'"):
        return string_node(parse_single_quoted(text), raw=text if preserve_raw else None)
    lowered = text.lower()
    if text in {"null", "~"}:
        return null_node(raw=text if preserve_raw else None)
    if lowered == "true":
        return bool_node(True, raw=text if preserve_raw else None)
    if lowered == "false":
        return bool_node(False, raw=text if preserve_raw else None)
    if INT_RE.fullmatch(text):
        return int_node(int(text, 10), raw=text if preserve_raw else None)
    if FLOAT_RE.fullmatch(text):
        return float_node(float(text), raw=text if preserve_raw else None)
    return string_node(text, raw=text if preserve_raw else None)


def json_to_node(text: str, flow_style: Optional[str] = None) -> Node:
    try:
        value = json.loads(text)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        raise YQError(str(exc)) from exc
    return python_to_node(value, style=flow_style)


def parse_inline_value(text: str) -> Node:
    stripped = text.strip()
    if stripped == "{}":
        return map_node({}, style="flow")
    if stripped == "[]":
        return seq_node([], style="flow")
    if stripped.startswith("{") or stripped.startswith("["):
        try:
            return json_to_node(stripped, flow_style="flow")
        except YQError:
            pass
    return parse_scalar_token(stripped, preserve_raw=True)


def split_mapping_entry(text: str) -> Optional[Tuple[str, str]]:
    in_single = False
    in_double = False
    escape = False
    depth = 0
    for index, char in enumerate(text):
        if in_double:
            if escape:
                escape = False
            elif char == "\\":
                escape = True
            elif char == '"':
                in_double = False
            continue
        if in_single:
            if char == "'":
                in_single = False
            continue
        if char == '"':
            in_double = True
            continue
        if char == "'":
            in_single = True
            continue
        if char in "{[":
            depth += 1
            continue
        if char in "}]":
            depth = max(0, depth - 1)
            continue
        if char == ":" and depth == 0:
            key = text[:index].strip()
            rest = text[index + 1 :]
            if rest.startswith(" "):
                rest = rest[1:]
            return key, rest
    return None


def parse_key_text(text: str) -> str:
    text = text.strip()
    if text.startswith('"') and text.endswith('"'):
        return json.loads(text)
    if text.startswith("'") and text.endswith("'"):
        return parse_single_quoted(text)
    return text


def parse_yaml_block(lines: List[ParsedLine], index: int, indent: int) -> Tuple[Node, int]:
    if index >= len(lines):
        return null_node(), index
    line = lines[index]
    if line.indent < indent:
        return null_node(), index
    if line.indent > indent:
        raise YQError("invalid yaml indentation")
    if line.text.startswith("-"):
        if line.text == "-" or line.text.startswith("- "):
            return parse_yaml_sequence(lines, index, indent)
    mapping_entry = split_mapping_entry(line.text)
    if mapping_entry is not None:
        return parse_yaml_mapping(lines, index, indent)
    return parse_scalar_token(line.text, preserve_raw=True), index + 1


def parse_yaml_mapping(lines: List[ParsedLine], index: int, indent: int) -> Tuple[Node, int]:
    mapping: Dict[str, Node] = {}
    while index < len(lines):
        line = lines[index]
        if line.indent < indent:
            break
        if line.indent != indent:
            break
        if line.text.startswith("-") and (line.text == "-" or line.text.startswith("- ")):
            break
        entry = split_mapping_entry(line.text)
        if entry is None:
            break
        key_text, rest = entry
        key = parse_key_text(key_text)
        index += 1
        if rest == "":
            if index < len(lines) and lines[index].indent > indent:
                value, index = parse_yaml_block(lines, index, lines[index].indent)
            else:
                value = null_node()
        else:
            value = parse_inline_value(rest)
        mapping[key] = value
    return map_node(mapping), index


def parse_yaml_mapping_continuation(
    lines: List[ParsedLine], index: int, indent: int, mapping: Dict[str, Node]
) -> Tuple[Node, int]:
    while index < len(lines):
        line = lines[index]
        if line.indent < indent:
            break
        if line.indent != indent:
            break
        if line.text.startswith("-") and (line.text == "-" or line.text.startswith("- ")):
            break
        entry = split_mapping_entry(line.text)
        if entry is None:
            break
        key_text, rest = entry
        key = parse_key_text(key_text)
        index += 1
        if rest == "":
            if index < len(lines) and lines[index].indent > indent:
                value, index = parse_yaml_block(lines, index, lines[index].indent)
            else:
                value = null_node()
        else:
            value = parse_inline_value(rest)
        mapping[key] = value
    return map_node(mapping), index


def parse_yaml_sequence(lines: List[ParsedLine], index: int, indent: int) -> Tuple[Node, int]:
    items: List[Node] = []
    while index < len(lines):
        line = lines[index]
        if line.indent < indent:
            break
        if line.indent != indent:
            break
        if not (line.text == "-" or line.text.startswith("- ")):
            break
        rest = line.text[1:]
        if rest.startswith(" "):
            rest = rest[1:]
        index += 1
        if rest == "":
            if index < len(lines) and lines[index].indent > indent:
                item, index = parse_yaml_block(lines, index, lines[index].indent)
            else:
                item = null_node()
        else:
            entry = split_mapping_entry(rest)
            if entry is not None:
                key_text, value_rest = entry
                mapping: Dict[str, Node] = {}
                key = parse_key_text(key_text)
                if value_rest == "":
                    if index < len(lines) and lines[index].indent > indent + 2:
                        value, index = parse_yaml_block(lines, index, lines[index].indent)
                    else:
                        value = null_node()
                else:
                    value = parse_inline_value(value_rest)
                mapping[key] = value
                item, index = parse_yaml_mapping_continuation(lines, index, indent + 2, mapping)
            else:
                item = parse_inline_value(rest)
        items.append(item)
    return seq_node(items), index


def parse_yaml_text(text: str) -> List[Node]:
    docs: List[Node] = []
    for doc_text in split_documents(text):
        lines = prepare_lines(doc_text)
        if not lines:
            docs.append(empty_node())
            continue
        doc, index = parse_yaml_block(lines, 0, lines[0].indent)
        if index < len(lines):
            raise YQError("could not parse yaml input")
        docs.append(doc)
    return docs


def read_input_text(path: str) -> str:
    if path == "-":
        return sys.stdin.read()
    try:
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            return handle.read()
    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
        raise YQError(f"open {path}: no such file or directory") from exc
    except OSError as exc:
        raise YQError(f"open {path}: {exc.strerror}") from exc


def normalize_format_name(name: str) -> str:
    normalized = name.lower()
    aliases = {
        "a": "auto",
        "auto": "auto",
        "y": "yaml",
        "yaml": "yaml",
        "ky": "yaml",
        "kyaml": "yaml",
        "j": "json",
        "json": "json",
    }
    if normalized in aliases:
        return aliases[normalized]
    raise YQError(f"unsupported format: {name}")


def detect_input_format(path: str, configured: str, text: str) -> str:
    if configured != "auto":
        return normalize_format_name(configured)
    if path != "-":
        lower = path.lower()
        if lower.endswith(".json"):
            return "json"
        if lower.endswith(".yaml") or lower.endswith(".yml"):
            return "yaml"
    stripped = text.lstrip()
    if stripped.startswith("{") or stripped.startswith("["):
        try:
            json.loads(stripped)
            return "json"
        except Exception:
            pass
    return "yaml"


def load_documents(path: str, input_format: str) -> Tuple[List[Node], str]:
    text = read_input_text(path)
    actual_format = detect_input_format(path, input_format, text)
    if actual_format == "json":
        docs = [json_to_node(text)]
    else:
        docs = parse_yaml_text(text)
    return docs, actual_format


def render_scalar_yaml(node: Node, quote_strings: bool = False) -> str:
    node = semantic_node(node)
    if node.kind == "null":
        return node.raw if node.raw is not None else "null"
    if node.kind == "bool":
        return node.raw if node.raw is not None else ("true" if node.value else "false")
    if node.kind == "int":
        return node.raw if node.raw is not None else str(node.value)
    if node.kind == "float":
        return node.raw if node.raw is not None else str(node.value)
    if node.kind == "string":
        if not quote_strings and node.raw is not None and not (node.raw.startswith('"') or node.raw.startswith("'")):
            return node.raw
        value = node.value
        if not quote_strings and value and not needs_yaml_quotes(value):
            return value
        return json.dumps(value)
    raise AssertionError("not a scalar")


def needs_yaml_quotes(text: str) -> bool:
    if text == "":
        return True
    if text.strip() != text:
        return True
    if text in {"null", "~", "true", "false"}:
        return True
    if INT_RE.fullmatch(text) or FLOAT_RE.fullmatch(text):
        return True
    bad_starts = "-?:,[]{}#&*!|>'\"%@`"
    if text[0] in bad_starts:
        return True
    return ": " in text or text.endswith(":")


def render_flow_yaml(node: Node) -> str:
    node = semantic_node(node)
    if node.kind == "map":
        parts = [f"{json.dumps(key)}: {render_flow_yaml(value)}" for key, value in node.value.items()]
        return "{" + ", ".join(parts) + "}"
    if node.kind == "seq":
        return "[" + ", ".join(render_flow_yaml(item) for item in node.value) + "]"
    return render_scalar_yaml(node, quote_strings=True)


def emit_yaml_lines(node: Node, indent: int, indent_step: int) -> List[str]:
    node = semantic_node(node)
    if is_scalar(node):
        return [(" " * indent) + render_scalar_yaml(node, quote_strings=True)]
    if node.style == "flow":
        return [(" " * indent) + render_flow_yaml(node)]
    if node.kind == "map":
        if not node.value:
            return [(" " * indent) + "{}"]
        lines: List[str] = []
        for key, value in node.value.items():
            key_text = key if not needs_yaml_quotes(key) else json.dumps(key)
            rendered_value = semantic_node(value)
            if rendered_value.style == "flow":
                lines.append((" " * indent) + f"{key_text}: {render_flow_yaml(rendered_value)}")
            elif is_scalar(rendered_value):
                lines.append((" " * indent) + f"{key_text}: {render_scalar_yaml(rendered_value, quote_strings=True)}")
            elif rendered_value.kind == "map" and not rendered_value.value:
                lines.append((" " * indent) + f"{key_text}: {{}}")
            elif rendered_value.kind == "seq" and not rendered_value.value:
                lines.append((" " * indent) + f"{key_text}: []")
            else:
                lines.append((" " * indent) + f"{key_text}:")
                lines.extend(emit_yaml_lines(rendered_value, indent + indent_step, indent_step))
        return lines
    if node.kind == "seq":
        if not node.value:
            return [(" " * indent) + "[]"]
        lines = []
        for item in node.value:
            rendered_item = semantic_node(item)
            prefix = " " * indent + "- "
            if rendered_item.style == "flow":
                lines.append(prefix + render_flow_yaml(rendered_item))
                continue
            if is_scalar(rendered_item):
                lines.append(prefix + render_scalar_yaml(rendered_item, quote_strings=True))
                continue
            if rendered_item.kind == "map":
                if not rendered_item.value:
                    lines.append(prefix + "{}")
                    continue
                first_key = next(iter(rendered_item.value))
                first_value = rendered_item.value[first_key]
                first_key_text = first_key if not needs_yaml_quotes(first_key) else json.dumps(first_key)
                first_rendered = semantic_node(first_value)
                if first_rendered.style == "flow":
                    lines.append(prefix + f"{first_key_text}: {render_flow_yaml(first_rendered)}")
                elif is_scalar(first_rendered):
                    lines.append(prefix + f"{first_key_text}: {render_scalar_yaml(first_rendered, quote_strings=True)}")
                elif first_rendered.kind == "map" and not first_rendered.value:
                    lines.append(prefix + f"{first_key_text}: {{}}")
                elif first_rendered.kind == "seq" and not first_rendered.value:
                    lines.append(prefix + f"{first_key_text}: []")
                else:
                    lines.append(prefix + f"{first_key_text}:")
                    lines.extend(emit_yaml_lines(first_rendered, indent + indent_step * 2, indent_step))
                rest_items = list(rendered_item.value.items())[1:]
                if rest_items:
                    rest_map = map_node(dict(rest_items))
                    lines.extend(emit_yaml_lines(rest_map, indent + indent_step, indent_step))
                continue
            if rendered_item.kind == "seq":
                if not rendered_item.value:
                    lines.append(prefix + "[]")
                else:
                    lines.append(" " * indent + "-")
                    lines.extend(emit_yaml_lines(rendered_item, indent + indent_step, indent_step))
        return lines
    raise AssertionError(f"cannot emit yaml for {node.kind}")


def render_yaml_document(node: Node, indent: int, unwrap_scalar: bool, top_level_empty_blank: bool) -> str:
    if node.kind == "empty" and top_level_empty_blank:
        return ""
    node = semantic_node(node)
    if is_scalar(node) and unwrap_scalar:
        if node.kind == "null":
            return "null"
        if node.kind == "bool":
            return "true" if node.value else "false"
        if node.kind in {"int", "float"}:
            return node.raw if node.raw is not None else str(node.value)
        return node.value
    return "\n".join(emit_yaml_lines(node, 0, indent))


def render_json_document(node: Node, indent: int) -> str:
    return json.dumps(node_to_python(node), indent=indent)


@dataclass
class Token:
    kind: str
    value: str


class Lexer:
    def __init__(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.text = text
        self.index = 0

    def tokenize(self) -> List[Token]:
        tokens: List[Token] = []
        while self.index < len(self.text):
            char = self.text[self.index]
            if char.isspace():
                self.index += 1
                continue
            if self.text.startswith("==", self.index):
                tokens.append(Token("EQ", "=="))
                self.index += 2
                continue
            if char in ".[](),|=*":
                mapping = {
                    ".": "DOT",
                    "[": "LBRACKET",
                    "]": "RBRACKET",
                    "(": "LPAREN",
                    ")": "RPAREN",
                    ",": "COMMA",
                    "|": "PIPE",
                    "=": "ASSIGN",
                    "*": "STAR",
                }
                tokens.append(Token(mapping[char], char))
                self.index += 1
                continue
            if char == '"':
                tokens.append(Token("STRING", self.read_double_quoted()))
                continue
            if char == "'":
                tokens.append(Token("STRING", self.read_single_quoted()))
                continue
            if char == "$":
                self.index += 1
                ident = self.read_identifier()
                tokens.append(Token("VAR", ident))
                continue
            if char.isdigit() or (char in "+-" and self.peek_number_start()):
                tokens.append(Token("NUMBER", self.read_number()))
                continue
            if char.isalpha() or char == "_":
                ident = self.read_identifier()
                tokens.append(Token("IDENT", ident))
                continue
            raise YQError(f"unexpected character: {char}")
        tokens.append(Token("EOF", ""))
        return tokens

    def peek_number_start(self) -> bool:
        if self.index + 1 >= len(self.text):
            return False
        nxt = self.text[self.index + 1]
        return nxt.isdigit() or nxt == "."

    def read_double_quoted(self) -> str:
        start = self.index
        self.index += 1
        escaped = False
        while self.index < len(self.text):
            char = self.text[self.index]
            if escaped:
                escaped = False
            elif char == "\\":
                escaped = True
            elif char == '"':
                self.index += 1
                return self.text[start:self.index]
            self.index += 1
        raise YQError("unterminated string")

    def read_single_quoted(self) -> str:
        start = self.index
        self.index += 1
        while self.index < len(self.text):
            char = self.text[self.index]
            if char == "'":
                self.index += 1
                return self.text[start:self.index]
            self.index += 1
        raise YQError("unterminated string")

    def read_identifier(self) -> str:
        start = self.index
        self.index += 1
        while self.index < len(self.text):
            char = self.text[self.index]
            if char.isalnum() or char == "_":
                self.index += 1
            else:
                break
        return self.text[start:self.index]

    def read_number(self) -> str:
        start = self.index
        if self.text[self.index] in "+-":
            self.index += 1
        while self.index < len(self.text) and self.text[self.index].isdigit():
            self.index += 1
        if self.index < len(self.text) and self.text[self.index] == ".":
            self.index += 1
            while self.index < len(self.text) and self.text[self.index].isdigit():
                self.index += 1
        if self.index < len(self.text) and self.text[self.index] in "eE":
            self.index += 1
            if self.index < len(self.text) and self.text[self.index] in "+-":
                self.index += 1
            while self.index < len(self.text) and self.text[self.index].isdigit():
                self.index += 1
        return self.text[start:self.index]


@dataclass
class EvalContext:
    security_disable_env_ops: bool = False
    security_disable_file_ops: bool = False
    file_index: int = 0
    document_index: int = 0


class Expr:
    def eval(self, current: Node, context: EvalContext) -> List[Node]:
        raise NotImplementedError


@dataclass
class IdentityExpr(Expr):
    def eval(self, current: Node, context: EvalContext) -> List[Node]:
        return [current]


@dataclass
class LiteralExpr(Expr):
    node: Node

    def eval(self, current: Node, context: EvalContext) -> List[Node]:
        return [self.node.clone()]


@dataclass
class IdentifierExpr(Expr):
    name: str

    def eval(self, current: Node, context: EvalContext) -> List[Node]:
        if self.name in {"fileIndex", "fi"}:
            return [int_node(context.file_index)]
        if self.name in {"documentIndex", "di"}:
            return [int_node(context.document_index)]
        if self.name == "type":
            return [string_node(node_tag(current), raw=node_tag(current))]
        if self.name == "null":
            return [null_node()]
        if self.name == "true":
            return [bool_node(True)]
        if self.name == "false":
            return [bool_node(False)]
        raise YQError(f"unknown identifier: {self.name}")


@dataclass
class PostfixOp:
    kind: str
    value: Any = None


@dataclass
class PostfixExpr(Expr):
    base: Expr
    ops: List[PostfixOp] = field(default_factory=list)

    def eval(self, current: Node, context: EvalContext) -> List[Node]:
        results = self.base.eval(current, context)
        for op in self.ops:
            next_results: List[Node] = []
            for node in results:
                next_results.extend(apply_postfix(node, op, current, context))
            results = next_results
        return results


@dataclass
class FunctionCallExpr(Expr):
    name: str
    args: List[Expr]

    def eval(self, current: Node, context: EvalContext) -> List[Node]:
        if self.name == "select":
            if len(self.args) != 1:
                raise YQError("select expects one argument")
            condition_results = self.args[0].eval(current, context)
            if any(node_truthy(node) for node in condition_results):
                return [current]
            return []
        if self.name == "load":
            if context.security_disable_file_ops:
                raise YQError("file operations have been disabled")
            if len(self.args) != 1:
                raise YQError("load expects one argument")
            path = expression_to_string(self.args[0], current, context)
            docs, _ = load_documents(path, "auto")
            if len(docs) == 1:
                return [docs[0]]
            return [seq_node([doc.clone() for doc in docs])]
        if self.name == "strenv":
            if context.security_disable_env_ops:
                raise YQError("env operations have been disabled")
            if len(self.args) != 1:
                raise YQError("strenv expects one argument")
            env_key = expression_to_env_name(self.args[0], current, context)
            return [string_node(os.environ.get(env_key, ""))]
        if self.name == "env":
            if context.security_disable_env_ops:
                raise YQError("env operations have been disabled")
            if len(self.args) != 1:
                raise YQError("env expects one argument")
            env_key = expression_to_env_name(self.args[0], current, context)
            if env_key not in os.environ:
                raise YQError(f"value for env variable '{env_key}' not provided in env()")
            return [parse_env_value(os.environ[env_key])]
        if self.name == "type":
            return [string_node(node_tag(current), raw=node_tag(current))]
        raise YQError(f"unknown function: {self.name}")


@dataclass
class ArrayExpr(Expr):
    items: List[Expr]

    def eval(self, current: Node, context: EvalContext) -> List[Node]:
        collected: List[Node] = []
        for expr in self.items:
            collected.extend(expr.eval(current, context))
        return [seq_node([item.clone() for item in collected])]


@dataclass
class PipeExpr(Expr):
    left: Expr
    right: Expr

    def eval(self, current: Node, context: EvalContext) -> List[Node]:
        results: List[Node] = []
        for item in self.left.eval(current, context):
            results.extend(self.right.eval(item, context))
        return results


@dataclass
class EqExpr(Expr):
    left: Expr
    right: Expr

    def eval(self, current: Node, context: EvalContext) -> List[Node]:
        left_results = self.left.eval(current, context)
        right_results = self.right.eval(current, context)
        left_node = left_results[0] if left_results else null_node()
        right_node = right_results[0] if right_results else null_node()
        return [bool_node(nodes_equal(left_node, right_node))]


@dataclass
class MulExpr(Expr):
    left: Expr
    right: Expr

    def eval(self, current: Node, context: EvalContext) -> List[Node]:
        left_results = self.left.eval(current, context)
        right_results = self.right.eval(current, context)
        left_node = left_results[0] if left_results else null_node()
        right_node = right_results[0] if right_results else null_node()
        return [merge_nodes(left_node, right_node)]


@dataclass
class AssignExpr(Expr):
    target: PostfixExpr
    value: Expr

    def eval(self, current: Node, context: EvalContext) -> List[Node]:
        path = assignment_path_from_expr(self.target)
        rhs_results = self.value.eval(current, context)
        if not rhs_results:
            rhs_results = [null_node()]
        outputs: List[Node] = []
        for rhs in rhs_results:
            base = current.clone()
            updated = assign_path(base, path, rhs.clone())
            outputs.append(updated)
        return outputs


def apply_postfix(node: Node, op: PostfixOp, root: Node, context: EvalContext) -> List[Node]:
    node = semantic_node(node) if op.kind == "iter" else node
    if op.kind == "field":
        if node.kind == "empty":
            return [null_node()]
        if node.kind == "null":
            return [null_node()]
        if node.kind == "map":
            if op.value in node.value:
                return [node.value[op.value]]
            return [null_node()]
        return []
    if op.kind == "index":
        if node.kind == "empty":
            return [null_node()]
        if node.kind == "null":
            return [null_node()]
        index_values = op.value.eval(root, context)
        if not index_values:
            return [null_node()]
        index_node = semantic_node(index_values[0])
        if index_node.kind == "int":
            index = index_node.value
            if node.kind == "seq":
                if index < 0:
                    index = len(node.value) + index
                if 0 <= index < len(node.value):
                    return [node.value[index]]
                return [null_node()]
            return []
        if index_node.kind == "string":
            if node.kind == "map":
                if index_node.value in node.value:
                    return [node.value[index_node.value]]
                return [null_node()]
            return []
        return []
    if op.kind == "iter":
        node = semantic_node(node)
        if node.kind == "seq":
            return list(node.value)
        if node.kind == "map":
            return list(node.value.values())
        return []
    raise AssertionError(f"unknown postfix op {op.kind}")


def expression_to_string(expr: Expr, current: Node, context: EvalContext) -> str:
    if isinstance(expr, LiteralExpr) and expr.node.kind == "string":
        return expr.node.value
    results = expr.eval(current, context)
    if not results:
        return ""
    result = semantic_node(results[0])
    if result.kind == "string":
        return result.value
    return str(node_to_python(result))


def expression_to_env_name(expr: Expr, current: Node, context: EvalContext) -> str:
    if isinstance(expr, IdentifierExpr):
        return expr.name
    return expression_to_string(expr, current, context)


def parse_env_value(text: str) -> Node:
    stripped = text.strip()
    if stripped.startswith("{") or stripped.startswith("["):
        try:
            return json_to_node(stripped, flow_style="flow")
        except YQError:
            pass
    return parse_scalar_token(text, preserve_raw=False)


def assignment_path_from_expr(expr: PostfixExpr) -> List[Tuple[str, Any]]:
    if not isinstance(expr.base, IdentityExpr):
        raise YQError("left-hand side of assignment must start at root")
    path: List[Tuple[str, Any]] = []
    for op in expr.ops:
        if op.kind == "field":
            path.append(("field", op.value))
        elif op.kind == "index":
            if isinstance(op.value, LiteralExpr):
                index_node = semantic_node(op.value.node)
                if index_node.kind == "int":
                    path.append(("index", index_node.value))
                elif index_node.kind == "string":
                    path.append(("field", index_node.value))
                else:
                    raise YQError("unsupported assignment index")
            else:
                raise YQError("unsupported assignment index")
        else:
            raise YQError("unsupported assignment target")
    return path


def assign_path(root: Node, path: List[Tuple[str, Any]], value: Node) -> Node:
    if not path:
        return value
    root = ensure_container_for_path(root, path[0][0])
    current = root
    for index, (kind, key) in enumerate(path):
        last = index == len(path) - 1
        next_kind = path[index + 1][0] if not last else None
        if kind == "field":
            current = ensure_map_node(current)
            if last:
                current.value[str(key)] = value
            else:
                child = current.value.get(str(key))
                if child is None:
                    child = create_container_for_kind(next_kind)
                    current.value[str(key)] = child
                else:
                    current.value[str(key)] = ensure_container_for_path(child, next_kind)
                current = current.value[str(key)]
        elif kind == "index":
            current = ensure_seq_node(current)
            idx = key
            if idx < 0:
                if len(current.value) == 0:
                    idx = 0
                else:
                    idx = len(current.value) + idx
            while len(current.value) <= idx:
                current.value.append(null_node())
            if last:
                current.value[idx] = value
            else:
                child = current.value[idx]
                current.value[idx] = ensure_container_for_path(child, next_kind)
                current = current.value[idx]
    return root


def ensure_container_for_path(node: Node, next_kind: str) -> Node:
    if node.kind in {"map", "seq"}:
        return node
    return create_container_for_kind(next_kind)


def create_container_for_kind(kind: str) -> Node:
    if kind == "index":
        return seq_node([])
    return map_node({})


def ensure_map_node(node: Node) -> Node:
    if node.kind == "map":
        return node
    return map_node({})


def ensure_seq_node(node: Node) -> Node:
    if node.kind == "seq":
        return node
    return seq_node([])


class Parser:
    def __init__(self, tokens: List[Token]) -> None:
        self.tokens = tokens
        self.index = 0

    def current(self) -> Token:
        return self.tokens[self.index]

    def advance(self) -> Token:
        token = self.tokens[self.index]
        self.index += 1
        return token

    def match(self, *kinds: str) -> bool:
        if self.current().kind in kinds:
            self.advance()
            return True
        return False

    def expect(self, kind: str) -> Token:
        token = self.current()
        if token.kind != kind:
            raise YQError(f"expected {kind}")
        self.index += 1
        return token

    def parse(self) -> Expr:
        expr = self.parse_assignment()
        self.expect("EOF")
        return expr

    def parse_assignment(self) -> Expr:
        expr = self.parse_pipe()
        if self.match("ASSIGN"):
            if self.current().kind == "EOF":
                raise YQError("'=' expects 2 args but there is 1")
            value = self.parse_assignment()
            if not isinstance(expr, PostfixExpr):
                raise YQError("invalid assignment target")
            return AssignExpr(expr, value)
        return expr

    def parse_pipe(self) -> Expr:
        expr = self.parse_eq()
        while self.match("PIPE"):
            expr = PipeExpr(expr, self.parse_eq())
        return expr

    def parse_eq(self) -> Expr:
        expr = self.parse_mul()
        while self.match("EQ"):
            expr = EqExpr(expr, self.parse_mul())
        return expr

    def parse_mul(self) -> Expr:
        expr = self.parse_postfix()
        while self.match("STAR"):
            expr = MulExpr(expr, self.parse_postfix())
        return expr

    def parse_postfix(self) -> Expr:
        expr = self.parse_primary()
        ops: List[PostfixOp] = []
        while True:
            if self.match("DOT"):
                ident = self.expect("IDENT").value
                ops.append(PostfixOp("field", ident))
                continue
            if self.match("LBRACKET"):
                if self.match("RBRACKET"):
                    ops.append(PostfixOp("iter"))
                else:
                    index_expr = self.parse_assignment()
                    self.expect("RBRACKET")
                    ops.append(PostfixOp("index", index_expr))
                continue
            break
        if ops:
            if isinstance(expr, PostfixExpr):
                return PostfixExpr(expr.base, expr.ops + ops)
            return PostfixExpr(expr, ops)
        return expr

    def parse_primary(self) -> Expr:
        token = self.current()
        if self.match("DOT"):
            return IdentityExpr()
        if self.match("LPAREN"):
            expr = self.parse_assignment()
            self.expect("RPAREN")
            return expr
        if self.match("LBRACKET"):
            items: List[Expr] = []
            if not self.match("RBRACKET"):
                items.append(self.parse_assignment())
                while self.match("COMMA"):
                    items.append(self.parse_assignment())
                self.expect("RBRACKET")
            return ArrayExpr(items)
        if token.kind == "STRING":
            self.advance()
            return LiteralExpr(parse_scalar_token(token.value, preserve_raw=False))
        if token.kind == "NUMBER":
            self.advance()
            return LiteralExpr(parse_scalar_token(token.value, preserve_raw=False))
        if token.kind == "IDENT":
            ident = self.advance().value
            if self.match("LPAREN"):
                args: List[Expr] = []
                if not self.match("RPAREN"):
                    args.append(self.parse_assignment())
                    while self.match("COMMA"):
                        args.append(self.parse_assignment())
                    self.expect("RPAREN")
                return FunctionCallExpr(ident, args)
            if ident == "null":
                return LiteralExpr(null_node())
            if ident == "true":
                return LiteralExpr(bool_node(True))
            if ident == "false":
                return LiteralExpr(bool_node(False))
            return IdentifierExpr(ident)
        raise YQError("could not parse expression")


def parse_expression(text: str) -> Expr:
    lexer = Lexer(text)
    tokens = lexer.tokenize()
    parser = Parser(tokens)
    return parser.parse()


IREDUCE_MERGE_RE = re.compile(
    r"^\s*\.\s+as\s+\$[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\s+ireduce\s*\(\s*\{\s*\}\s*;\s*\.\s*\*\s*\$[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\s*\)\s*$"
)


def is_ireduce_merge_all(expr_text: str) -> bool:
    return bool(IREDUCE_MERGE_RE.match(expr_text))


def collect_file_index_merge_terms(expr: Expr) -> Optional[List[int]]:
    terms: List[int] = []

    def walk(node: Expr) -> bool:
        if isinstance(node, MulExpr):
            return walk(node.left) and walk(node.right)
        if not isinstance(node, FunctionCallExpr) or node.name != "select" or len(node.args) != 1:
            return False
        condition = node.args[0]
        if not isinstance(condition, EqExpr):
            return False
        if not isinstance(condition.left, IdentifierExpr):
            return False
        if condition.left.name not in {"fileIndex", "fi"}:
            return False
        if not isinstance(condition.right, LiteralExpr):
            return False
        right = semantic_node(condition.right.node)
        if right.kind != "int":
            return False
        terms.append(right.value)
        return True

    return terms if walk(expr) else None


@dataclass
class OutputRecord:
    rendered: str
    format_name: str
    semantic: Node
    group_id: int


def compile_expression(expr_text: str) -> Optional[Expr]:
    if not expr_text.strip():
        return None
    return parse_expression(expr_text)


def stdin_has_data() -> bool:
    try:
        return not os.isatty(sys.stdin.fileno())
    except Exception:
        return False


def render_outputs(records: List[OutputRecord], no_doc: bool, nul_output: bool) -> None:
    current_group: Optional[int] = None
    first_emitted_group = True
    separator = "\0" if nul_output else "\n"
    wrote_anything = False
    for index, record in enumerate(records):
        if current_group != record.group_id:
            if (
                not first_emitted_group
                and record.format_name == "yaml"
                and not no_doc
            ):
                sys.stdout.write("---\n")
            current_group = record.group_id
            first_emitted_group = False
        sys.stdout.write(record.rendered)
        sys.stdout.write(separator)
        wrote_anything = True
    if wrote_anything:
        sys.stdout.flush()


def evaluate_standard(
    expr: Optional[Expr],
    expr_text: str,
    docs: List[Tuple[Node, str, int, int, bool]],
    output_format: str,
    indent: int,
    unwrap_scalar: bool,
) -> List[OutputRecord]:
    records: List[OutputRecord] = []
    for node, source_format, group_id, file_index, from_null_input in docs:
        context = EvalContext()
        context.file_index = file_index
        results = [node] if expr is None else expr.eval(node, context)
        if not results:
            continue
        format_name = normalize_format_name(output_format) if output_format != "auto" else source_format
        for result in results:
            top_level_empty_blank = from_null_input and result.kind == "empty" and format_name == "yaml"
            rendered = (
                render_yaml_document(result, indent, unwrap_scalar, top_level_empty_blank)
                if format_name == "yaml"
                else render_json_document(result, indent)
            )
            records.append(OutputRecord(rendered, format_name, semantic_node(result), group_id))
    return records


def evaluate_eval_all_special(
    expr_text: str,
    expr: Optional[Expr],
    docs: List[Tuple[Node, str, int, int, bool]],
    output_format: str,
    indent: int,
    unwrap_scalar: bool,
) -> Optional[List[OutputRecord]]:
    if is_ireduce_merge_all(expr_text):
        merged = map_node({})
        for node, _, _, _, _ in docs:
            merged = merge_nodes(merged, node)
        format_name = normalize_format_name(output_format) if output_format != "auto" else "yaml"
        rendered = (
            render_yaml_document(merged, indent, unwrap_scalar, False)
            if format_name == "yaml"
            else render_json_document(merged, indent)
        )
        return [OutputRecord(rendered, format_name, semantic_node(merged), 0)]
    if expr is None:
        return None
    merge_terms = collect_file_index_merge_terms(expr)
    if merge_terms is None:
        return None
    selected: List[Node] = []
    for term in merge_terms:
        for node, _, _, file_index, _ in docs:
            if file_index == term:
                selected.append(node)
    merged = null_node()
    for node in selected:
        merged = merge_nodes(merged, node)
    format_name = normalize_format_name(output_format) if output_format != "auto" else "yaml"
    rendered = (
        render_yaml_document(merged, indent, unwrap_scalar, False)
        if format_name == "yaml"
        else render_json_document(merged, indent)
    )
    return [OutputRecord(rendered, format_name, semantic_node(merged), 0)]


def determine_exit_status(records: List[OutputRecord], exit_status_flag: bool) -> int:
    if not exit_status_flag:
        return 0
    if not records:
        raise YQError("no matches found")
    if all(record.semantic.kind in {"null", "bool"} and not node_truthy(record.semantic) for record in records):
        raise YQError("no matches found")
    return 0


def read_expression_from_file(path: str) -> str:
    try:
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            return handle.read()
    except FileNotFoundError as exc:
        raise YQError(f"open {path}: no such file or directory") from exc
    except OSError as exc:
        raise YQError(f"open {path}: {exc.strerror}") from exc

def parse_bool_value(text: str) -> bool:
    lowered = text.lower()
    if lowered in {"true", "1"}:
        return True
    if lowered in {"false", "0"}:
        return False
    raise YQError(f"invalid boolean value: {text}")


def parse_args(argv: List[str]) -> Tuple[str, Dict[str, Any], List[str]]:
    options = default_options()
    if argv and argv[0] in {"eval", "e"}:
        command = "eval"
        args = argv[1:]
    elif argv and argv[0] in {"eval-all", "ea"}:
        command = "eval-all"
        args = argv[1:]
    elif argv and argv[0] == "help":
        return "help", options, argv[1:]
    elif argv and argv[0] == "completion":
        return "completion", options, argv[1:]
    else:
        command = "eval"
        args = argv[:]

    positionals: List[str] = []
    index = 0
    while index < len(args):
        arg = args[index]
        if arg == "--":
            positionals.extend(args[index + 1 :])
            break
        if not arg.startswith("-") or arg == "-":
            positionals.append(arg)
            index += 1
            continue
        if arg.startswith("--"):
            name_value = arg[2:]
            if "=" in name_value:
                name, value = name_value.split("=", 1)
            else:
                name, value = name_value, None
            if name in KNOWN_LONG_BOOL_FLAGS:
                options[name] = True if value is None else parse_bool_value(value)
                index += 1
                continue
            if name in KNOWN_LONG_STRING_FLAGS:
                if value is None:
                    index += 1
                    if index >= len(args):
                        raise YQError(f"flag needs an argument: --{name}")
                    value = args[index]
                options[name] = value
                index += 1
                continue
            if name in KNOWN_LONG_INT_FLAGS:
                if value is None:
                    index += 1
                    if index >= len(args):
                        raise YQError(f"flag needs an argument: --{name}")
                    value = args[index]
                options[name] = int(value)
                index += 1
                continue
            raise YQError(f"unknown flag: --{name}")
        short = arg[1:]
        consumed = False
        while short:
            flag_char = short[0]
            if flag_char not in SHORT_FLAG_MAP:
                raise YQError(f"unknown shorthand flag: '{flag_char}' in -{arg[1:]}")
            name, kind = SHORT_FLAG_MAP[flag_char]
            short = short[1:]
            if kind == "bool":
                if short.startswith("="):
                    options[name] = parse_bool_value(short[1:])
                    short = ""
                else:
                    options[name] = True
                continue
            if kind == "string":
                if short.startswith("="):
                    options[name] = short[1:]
                    short = ""
                elif short:
                    options[name] = short
                    short = ""
                else:
                    index += 1
                    if index >= len(args):
                        raise YQError(f"flag needs an argument: -{flag_char}")
                    options[name] = args[index]
                consumed = True
                break
            if kind == "int":
                if short.startswith("="):
                    raw = short[1:]
                    short = ""
                elif short:
                    raw = short
                    short = ""
                else:
                    index += 1
                    if index >= len(args):
                        raise YQError(f"flag needs an argument: -{flag_char}")
                    raw = args[index]
                options[name] = int(raw)
                consumed = True
                break
        index += 1
        if consumed:
            continue
    return command, options, positionals


def determine_expression_and_files(
    options: Dict[str, Any], positionals: List[str]
) -> Tuple[Optional[str], List[str]]:
    expression = options["expression"]
    if options["from-file"]:
        expression = read_expression_from_file(options["from-file"])
    files = positionals[:]
    if expression is None:
        if files:
            first = files[0]
            if first == "-" or os.path.exists(first):
                expression = "."
            else:
                expression = first
                files = files[1:]
        else:
            if options["null-input"]:
                return None, []
            if stdin_has_data():
                expression = "."
                files = ["-"]
            else:
                return None, []
    return expression, files


def build_doc_stream(files: List[str], options: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[Tuple[Node, str, int, int, bool]]:
    docs: List[Tuple[Node, str, int, int, bool]] = []
    group_id = 0
    if options["null-input"]:
        docs.append((empty_node(), "yaml", group_id, 0, True))
        return docs
    if not files:
        files = ["-"]
    for file_index, path in enumerate(files):
        loaded_docs, source_format = load_documents(path, options["input-format"])
        for document_index, doc in enumerate(loaded_docs):
            docs.append((doc, source_format, group_id, file_index, False))
            group_id += 1
    return docs


def run_eval_like(command: str, options: Dict[str, Any], positionals: List[str]) -> int:
    expression_text, files = determine_expression_and_files(options, positionals)
    if expression_text is None:
        return 0
    expr = compile_expression(expression_text)
    docs = build_doc_stream(files, options)
    for entry in docs:
        pass
    if command == "eval-all":
        for index, item in enumerate(docs):
            node, source_format, group_id, file_index, from_null_input = item
            docs[index] = (node, source_format, group_id, file_index, from_null_input)
        records = evaluate_eval_all_special(
            expression_text,
            expr,
            docs,
            options["output-format"],
            options["indent"],
            options["unwrapScalar"],
        )
        if records is None:
            records = evaluate_standard(
                expr,
                expression_text,
                docs,
                options["output-format"],
                options["indent"],
                options["unwrapScalar"],
            )
    else:
        records = evaluate_standard(
            expr,
            expression_text,
            docs,
            options["output-format"],
            options["indent"],
            options["unwrapScalar"],
        )

    if options["inplace"]:
        if not files:
            raise YQError("write inplace flag only applicable when giving an expression and at least one file")
        if not records:
            return determine_exit_status(records, options["exit-status"])
        first_path = files[0]
        target_format = normalize_format_name(options["output-format"]) if options["output-format"] != "auto" else records[0].format_name
        payload = records[0].rendered
        if payload != "":
            payload += "\n"
        with open(first_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            handle.write(payload)
        return determine_exit_status(records, options["exit-status"])

    render_outputs(records, options["no-doc"], options["nul-output"])
    return determine_exit_status(records, options["exit-status"])


def print_help_for(command: Optional[str], with_banner: bool = True) -> None:
    if command in {None, ""}:
        sys.stdout.write(ROOT_HELP_WITH_BANNER if with_banner else ROOT_HELP_NO_BANNER)
        return
    if command in {"eval", "e"}:
        sys.stdout.write(EVAL_HELP)
        return
    if command in {"eval-all", "ea"}:
        sys.stdout.write(EVAL_ALL_HELP)
        return
    if command == "completion":
        sys.stdout.write("Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell\n")
        return
    sys.stdout.write(ROOT_HELP_WITH_BANNER if with_banner else ROOT_HELP_NO_BANNER)


def completion_script(shell: str) -> str:
    if shell == "bash":
        return """# bash completion for yq
_yq_completion() {
  COMPREPLY=()
  local cur="${COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}"
  local commands="eval eval-all help completion"
  COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W "${commands}" -- "${cur}") )
}
complete -F _yq_completion yq
"""
    if shell == "zsh":
        return """#compdef yq
_arguments '*: :((eval eval-all help completion))'
"""
    if shell == "fish":
        return "complete -c yq -f -a 'eval eval-all help completion'\n"
    if shell in {"powershell", "pwsh"}:
        return "Register-ArgumentCompleter -CommandName yq -ScriptBlock { param($wordToComplete) 'eval','eval-all','help','completion' | Where-Object { $_ -like \"$wordToComplete*\" } }\n"
    raise YQError("unsupported shell for completion")


def main(argv: List[str]) -> int:
    try:
        command, options, positionals = parse_args(argv)
        if command == "help":
            target = positionals[0] if positionals else None
            print_help_for(target, with_banner=True)
            return 0
        if command == "completion":
            if positionals and positionals[0] in {"-h", "--help"}:
                print_help_for("completion", with_banner=True)
                return 0
            shell = positionals[0] if positionals else "bash"
            sys.stdout.write(completion_script(shell))
            return 0
        if options["version"]:
            sys.stdout.write(VERSION_TEXT + "\n")
            return 0
        if options["help"]:
            print_help_for(command, with_banner=True)
            return 0
        if not argv:
            print_help_for(None, with_banner=False)
            return 0
        if command == "eval":
            expression_text, files = determine_expression_and_files(options, positionals)
            if expression_text is None and not options["null-input"] and not files:
                print_help_for(None, with_banner=False)
                return 0
            return run_eval_like(command, options, positionals)
        if command == "eval-all":
            return run_eval_like(command, options, positionals)
        print_help_for(None, with_banner=True)
        return 0
    except YQError as exc:
        sys.stderr.write(f"Error: {exc}\n")
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

def collect_file_index_merge_terms(expr: Expr) -> Optional[List[int]]:
    terms: List[int] = []

    def walk(node: Expr) -> bool:
        if isinstance(node, MulExpr):
            return walk(node.left) and walk(node.right)
        if not isinstance(node, FunctionCallExpr) or node.name != "select" or len(node.args) != 1:
            return False
        condition = node.args[0]
        if not isinstance(condition, EqExpr):
            return False
        if not isinstance(condition.left, IdentifierExpr):
            return False
        if condition.left.name not in {"fileIndex", "fi"}:
            return False
        if not isinstance(condition.right, LiteralExpr):
            return False
        right = semantic_node(condition.right.node)
        if right.kind != "int":
            return False
        terms.append(right.value)
        return True

    return terms if walk(expr) else None

def compile_expression(expr_text: str) -> Optional[Expr]:

def render_outputs(records: List[OutputRecord], no_doc: bool, nul_output: bool) -> None:
    current_group: Optional[int] = None
    first_emitted_group = True
    separator = "\0" if nul_output else "\n"
    wrote_anything = False
    for index, record in enumerate(records):
        if current_group != record.group_id:
            if (
                not first_emitted_group
                and record.format_name == "yaml"
                and not no_doc
            ):
                sys.stdout.write("---\n")
            current_group = record.group_id
            first_emitted_group = False
        sys.stdout.write(record.rendered)
        sys.stdout.write(separator)
        wrote_anything = True
    if wrote_anything:
        sys.stdout.flush()

def parse_bool_value(text: str) -> bool:
    lowered = text.lower()
    if lowered in {"true", "1"}:

    if lowered in {"false", "0"}:
        return False
    raise YQError(f"invalid boolean value: {text}")


def parse_args(argv: List[str]) -> Tuple[str, Dict[str, Any], List[str]]:
    options = default_options()
    if argv and argv[0] in {"eval", "e"}:
        command = "eval"
        args = argv[1:]
    elif argv and argv[0] in {"eval-all", "ea"}:

    elif argv and argv[0] == "help":
        return "help", options, argv[1:]
    elif argv and argv[0] == "completion":
        return "completion", options, argv[1:]
    else:
        command = "eval"
        args = argv[:]

    positionals: List[str] = []
    index = 0
    while index < len(args):
        arg = args[index]
        if arg == "--":
            positionals.extend(args[index + 1 :])
            break
        if not arg.startswith("-") or arg == "-":
            positionals.append(arg)

            continue
        if arg.startswith("--"):
            name_value = arg[2:]
            if "=" in name_value:
                name, value = name_value.split("=", 1)
            else:
                name, value = name_value, None
            if name in KNOWN_LONG_BOOL_FLAGS:
                options[name] = True if value is None else parse_bool_value(value)
                index += 1
                continue
            if name in KNOWN_LONG_STRING_FLAGS:
                if value is None:
                    index += 1
                    if index >= len(args):
                        raise YQError(f"flag needs an argument: --{name}")
                    value = args[index]
                options[name] = value
                index += 1
                continue
            if name in KNOWN_LONG_INT_FLAGS:
                if value is None:
                    index += 1
                    if index >= len(args):
                        raise YQError(f"flag needs an argument: --{name}")
                    value = args[index]
                options[name] = int(value)
                index += 1
                continue
            raise YQError(f"unknown flag: --{name}")
        short = arg[1:]
        consumed = False
        while short:
            flag_char = short[0]
            if flag_char not in SHORT_FLAG_MAP:
                raise YQError(f"unknown shorthand flag: '{flag_char}' in -{arg[1:]}")
            name, kind = SHORT_FLAG_MAP[flag_char]
            short = short[1:]
            if kind == "bool":
                if short.startswith("="):
                    options[name] = parse_bool_value(short[1:])
                    short = ""
                else:
                    options[name] = True
                continue
            if kind == "string":
                if short.startswith("="):
                    options[name] = short[1:]
                    short = ""
                elif short:
                    options[name] = short
                    short = ""
                else:
                    index += 1
                    if index >= len(args):
                        raise YQError(f"flag needs an argument: -{flag_char}")
                    options[name] = args[index]

                    raw = short[1:]
                    short = ""

                    raw = short
                    short = ""
                else:
                    index += 1
                    if index >= len(args):
                        raise YQError(f"flag needs an argument: -{flag_char}")

                consumed = True
                break
        index += 1
        if consumed:
            continue
    return command, options, positionals

  ref_err=$(mktemp)
  impl_out=$(mktemp)

    echo "REF CMD: $ref_cmd"

    echo "-- ref stderr --"

    echo "-- impl stderr --"
